screen1-a1.where: Top left corner, a round button with two short horizontal lines, no words.
screen1-a1.expectation: It opens a side menu, probably my list of past chats.
screen1-a1.cue: Only the two-line picture in the corner; I have learnt that shape from other apps.

first_pass.why: There is no word on it. I can guess it is a menu, but I cannot be certain what is inside, and I could not say its name aloud to my speech software.
first_pass.solution: Put the word 'Menu' or 'Chats' under or beside the lines.

test_cases.targets: whether pressing the two-line picture at the top left shows what it is for
test_cases.action: Pressed the two-line picture at the top left and looked.
test_cases.problem_is_real_if: pressing it surprises you, or you could only find out what it was for by trying it, or you still can't tell
test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: what happens matches what you expected from what you saw, and you would now say it was plain before you pressed it
test_cases.what_happened: A side list slid in from the left: Images, Library, Projects, Scheduled, Plugins, then a list of my past chats. It is the menu I guessed, and it does the same thing every time.

screen1-a1.closing_comment: It did exactly what I guessed, and it is the same on every screen, so I can learn it once. It still has no word I could say to my speech software.

screen1-a2.where: Top left, blue-tinted button with a star and the words 'Get Plus'.
screen1-a2.expectation: It takes me to pay for an upgraded version of the app.
screen1-a2.cue: The words 'Get Plus' and the sparkle star.

first_pass.why: The words say it. I know 'Plus' means the paid version.

screen1-a3.where: Top right corner, a round button with a speech bubble drawn with a circular arrow in it, no words.
screen1-a3.expectation: I honestly do not know. It could refresh the chat, start a new chat, or show chat history.
screen1-a3.cue: Nothing I can rely on. The circle of arrows makes me think 'refresh', the bubble shape makes me think 'chat'.

first_pass.why: It could mean at least three different things, and I would read it over and over without committing. I would not press it, and I have no word to say to it.
first_pass.solution: Put a clear word on it, such as 'New chat', or replace it with a plain pencil-and-paper or plus sign plus that word.

test_cases.targets: whether pressing the round speech-bubble picture at the top right tells you what it is for
test_cases.action: Pressed the speech-bubble picture at the top right, looked, then pressed it again.

test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: what happens matches what you expected from what you saw, and you would now say it was plain before you pressed it
test_cases.what_happened: It switched on 'Temporary chat': the middle of the screen said 'Temporary chat - This chat won't appear in history', a 'Personalized' choice appeared, the text box said 'Temporary chat', and the picture changed to a bubble with a tick. Pressing again switched it off; for a moment the screen showed 'Unpersonalized' before returning to normal.

screen1-a3.closing_comment: It was none of my three guesses - it changes whether my chat is saved, which is a big thing to hide behind an unnamed picture. The screen explains it only after I have pressed it.

screen1-a4.expectation: It starts a spoken conversation with the app.

first_pass.why: The words are explicit and the headphones match them.
